Class GuardrailAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.gridynamics.forge.guardrail.config.GuardrailAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @EnableConfigurationProperties(GuardrailProperties.class) public class GuardrailAutoConfiguration extends Object
Spring Boot auto-configuration for guardrail validators and web support.
